authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/dreadbox/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/dreadbox/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the CC list, with its printed name, sent as a control change on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The list prints each value as the instrument shows it (`[0 - 99]`, `[-99 - 99]`, `[SINE, TRI, SAW, RMP, SQR, RND]`) and does not say how the controller's 0 - 127 map to it. It is taken as the Artemis's list says its own are: spread over 0 - 127, a setting sent at the middle of its share. Try one on the instrument before relying on it.
Left out, the wheel, the pedals, bank select and the channel mode messages: CC 1 ModWheel, CC 64 Sustain Pedal, CC 120 All Sound off, CC 123 All Noise off.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same controllers when its panel is used, where its MIDI settings allow
